Digits sum to 13 and difference of the number and its reversal is 27, so 9(a−b)=27 and a−b=3. Then a+b=13 and a−b=3 give 2a=16, so a=8 and b=5. The number is 85, its reverse is 58, and 85−58=27 ✓. The sum is 85+58=143.

Solution A wrongly lists pairs, omits (8,5), and claims (7,4) works, though 7+4=11≠13. Its answer of 121 is wrong.

Solution B is correct.

WINNER: B
